landing.hero_desc: HeyGeo is a platform for sharing 2D & 3D dynamic math models.
landing.newest_desc: Models recently shared by the community.
landing.popular_desc: Models most loved and viewed by the community.
landing.gallery_cta_desc: Discover the full collection of math models shared by the community

features.viz_desc: Dynamic math representations are displayed with rigorous mathematical relationships. You can interact with math objects directly in the browser.
features.share_desc: Every HeyGeo, Sketchpad, Web Sketchpad, or GeoGebra model has its own share link. You can add a description and exploration instructions to help viewers understand the model.
features.integrate_desc: Design your model in HeyGeo Desktop, then publish directly to heygeo.pedu.vn via File → Export to Web. You can also upload models created in other dynamic geometry apps.
features.manage_desc: A personal dashboard for each user. Manage all your models, control public/private settings, and upload or edit models with ease.
features.security_desc: Robust security technologies. Publish models to the web via an authenticated API, ensuring only you can manage your models.
features.stats_desc: Track the view count of your publicly shared models. Know which models the community finds most interesting.

steps.step1_desc: Register a new account with your email. Quick and easy.
steps.step2_desc: Design in HeyGeo Desktop or directly on the web via <webCoding>HeyGeo Web Coding</webCoding> or <webDesign>HeyGeo Web Design</webDesign>. Create as many models as you like. You can also upload files from Sketchpad, Web Sketchpad, or GeoGebra.
steps.step3_desc: Enable public mode, add a description and exploration notes, then share the link with students and colleagues.
